description: CREATE a game-ready weapon GLB (knife, gun, sword) and save it to Library as kind=weapon. Default Meshy, no T-pose, no rig. polycount default 4000. style=melee|gun for attach. 10 credits. Do NOT write one-off Meshy scripts.

engine.description: GPU engine, only with provider gpu: hunyuan (Hunyuan3D 2.1, shape then paint) or trellis2 (TRELLIS.2). Server default GRIPFORGE_GPU_ENGINE, else hunyuan.

idempotency_key.description: Stable asset request key; reuse after an uncertain response.

out_dir.description: After the durable job completes, use gripforge_library_pull with this out_dir.

prompt.description: e.g. tactical combat knife, silver blade, black grip. Up to 2000 characters: the on-demand GPU (provider gpu) always takes them; another provider refuses a text over its own limit with the error prompt_too_long_for_provider.

provider.description: Default meshy (or the server default). gpu = our rented GPU: Hunyuan3D 2.1 (default engine) or TRELLIS.2 image-to-3D, then the game-ready chain (shape gate, normalisation, decimation, normal + AO bake from the high-poly, collider for props/weapons, meta.gameReady verdict); text-only first makes a concept image; no Tripo/Meshy spend. The server default can be gpu (GRIPFORGE_FORGE_DEFAULT=gpu|meshy).

style.description: Grip style for attach (inferred if omitted)

name: gripforge_generate_weapon
